q: A stone is thrown vertically upwards at 30 m/s from the top of a cliff. It hits the foot of the cliff 9 s later. Find the height of the cliff. (g = 10 m/s²)
s:
Take upward as positive. The displacement at landing is −h.
−h = ut − ½gt² = 30 × 9 − 5 × 9²
−h = 270 − 405
h = 135 m

q:
A truck moving at a steady 10 m/s passes a stationary police car. At that instant the police car starts from rest with a uniform acceleration of 2 m/s². After how long does it catch up with the truck?
Give the answer in s.
s:
They meet when both have covered the same distance.
Truck: s = vt = 10t.  Police car: s = ½at² = 1t².
10t = 1t², so t = {2 × 10;2}
t = 10 s

q: A train starts from rest and speeds up at 2 m/s² for 5 s. It then runs at constant speed for 7 s and finally slows uniformly to rest in 10 s. Find the total distance travelled.
s:
Top speed v = at = 2 × 5 = 10 m/s.
Speeding up: s₁ = ½at² = 25 m.
Constant speed: s₂ = v × 7 = 70 m.
Slowing down (average speed v/2): s₃ = {v;2} × 10 = 50 m.
Total = 25 + 70 + 50 = 145 m.

q:
A driver travelling at 30 m/s sees a hazard. Her reaction time is 1 s, after which she brakes with a retardation of 4 m/s². Find the total distance covered from the moment she sees the hazard until the car stops.
Give the answer in m.
s:
During the reaction time the speed is constant: s₁ = 30 × 1 = 30 m.
Braking: s₂ = u² ÷ 2a = 900 ÷ 8 = 112.5 m.
Total = 30 + 112.5 = 142.5 m.

q:
A ball is released from rest at a height of 25 m. With what speed does it strike the ground? (Take g = 10 m/s², ignore air.)
Give the answer in m/s, correct to 2 decimal places.
s:
Dropped from rest: v² = 2gh.
v² = 2 × 10 × 25 = 500
v = √500 = 22.36 m/s

q: A ball is thrown vertically upwards with a speed of 44 m/s. What maximum height does it reach? (g = 10 m/s²)
s:
At the top v = 0. Use v² = u² − 2gh.
0 = 44² − 2 × 10 × h
h = 1936 ÷ 20
h = 96.8 m
